note: Round 3. No AI imagery. The licensed product photo is a studio shot, so it is placed on a drawn studio sweep lit the same way, with a contact shadow along the product's own bottom edge and a faint satin-floor reflection (studio_render.py, jobs in more/studio-<product>/*.json). Camera moves (push-in, close-up, slide, pull-back) are rendered from the original photo pixels every frame. Narration is VoxCPM2 TTS, so the label says the voice is AI. Round 2 lifestyle-set composites were rejected in review: the AI camera kept moving and the product floated.
